properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 10:39AM EDT until August 10 at 11:45AM EDT by NWS Buffalo NY
properties.description:

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Erie from Ripley to Sturgeon Point...

* Until 1145 AM EDT.

13 nm northeast of Erie, moving northeast at 45 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

Sunset Bay.
properties.instruction:

expected.

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 10 at 9:50AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Chesapeake Bay from Pooles Island to Sandy Point MD...
Chesapeake Bay north of Pooles Island MD...
Patapsco River including Baltimore Harbor...

At 949 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a gust front, capable of
producing winds to around 30 knots. This front was located along a
line extending from 11 nm north of Havre De Grace to 14 nm northwest
of Middle River to 27 nm west of Back River, moving southeast at 25
knots.

Thunderstorms may also affect the Chesapeake Bay north of Pooles
Island, but gusty winds will reach the waters well before rain
arrives.

The front will be near...
Havre De Grace around 1005 AM EDT.
Gunpowder River around 1010 AM EDT.
Aberdeen Proving Ground and Northeast River around 1015 AM EDT.
Turkey Point and Spesutie Island around 1020 AM EDT.
Pooles Island, Hart Miller Island, and North Point State Park
around 1025 AM EDT.
Worton Point around 1030 AM EDT.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until these storms pass.
properties.area: Chesapeake Bay north of Pooles Island MD; Chesapeake Bay from Pooles Island to Sandy Point MD; Patapsco River including Baltimore Harbor

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 10 at 9:35AM EDT until August 10 at 12:45PM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of northwest Ohio, including the following
counties, Allen OH, Defiance, Henry, Paulding and Putnam.

* WHEN...Until 1245 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 935 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2.5 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Ottawa, Bluffton, Columbus Grove, Kalida, Pandora,
Continental, Glandorf, Oakwood, Dupont, Gilboa, Cloverdale,
Miller City, Kieferville, Vaughnsville, Wisterman, North
Creek, Rockport and Pleasant Bend.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
properties.area: Allen, OH; Defiance, OH; Henry, OH; Paulding, OH; Putnam, OH

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 10 at 2:48AM CDT until August 10 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Livingston County in central Illinois...
North Central Ford County in east central Illinois...
Iroquois County in east central Illinois...
Southeastern Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...
Southwestern Kankakee County in northeastern Illinois...
Benton County in northwestern Indiana...
Southwestern Newton County in northwestern Indiana...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT /1100 AM EDT/ Tonight.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Roads and
streets may be flooded. Slow moving or standing water may continue.
High water may recede slowly from flooded areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 248 AM CDT /348 AM EDT/, Doppler radar and automated rain
gauges indicated heavy rainfall moving out of the area, but some
streams will continue to rise due to earlier heavy rainfall.
Standing water may also be slow to recede in some areas. Up to 3
inches of rain occurred in northeastern Livingston County.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Streator, Watseka, Dwight, Fowler, Gilman, Kentland, Herscher,
Clifton, Milford, Otterbein, Onarga, Oxford, Sheldon, Odell,
South Streator, Boswell, Ashkum, Cullom, Martinton and Earl Park.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Advisory means minor flooding along waterways and other poor
drainage areas is imminent or may already be occurring. Persons in
the advisory area should use caution and avoid flood waters.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.
properties.area: Ford, IL; Grundy, IL; Iroquois, IL; Kankakee, IL; Livingston, IL; Benton, IN; Newton, IN
